result.rationale: The Letter of Award is firm and the 1,089 crore project cost is 31.5 percent of TTM revenue of 3,452.52 crore, multi-year total. The company regularly wins orders of this size, so the award is routine, but the price to sales of 1.37 is below the 1.5 cheap-valuation threshold and TTM operating margin is 14 percent, so the exception applies and it is decided as not routine. The company is profitable and has no disqualifier, though TTM revenue growth is not shown and the order book check found no company total in the listed documents.
result.what_changed: A single 1,089 crore highway award is far larger than the company's typical EPC wins, but the company also reports regular orders of this scale, with H1FY26 orders of 3,747 crore and an order book of about 10,300 crore at Jun 2025. Under the cheap-valuation exception (price to sales 1.37) the award is decided as not routine. The 2026 Velgaon substation LoI to acquire a REC subsidiary is a conditional LoI and is not firm.
contradictions: Routine by the company's own order history: H1FY26 orders of 3,747 crore and several 1,000-plus crore awards and L1 bids in 2025, so routine status is decided only through the valuation exception
The 1,089 crore figure is a total over the HAM build period, not a single-year revenue amount
Finance cost is about 40 crore a quarter, so the project requires financial closure and debt funding on top of existing borrowing
Revenue growth for TTM is not shown in the valuation section; Q1 FY26 revenue was up 1.9 percent year on year, and PAT fell 34 percent in that quarter
result.next_milestone: Financial closure and start of work on the Indore-Ujjain HAM project (milestone 28 Dec 2027 per the packet), and quarterly revenue lifting above the roughly 840 crore run-rate
